scope: Isolated exact imported candidate helper with actual native31-date scroller/styles. Native input cancellation plus deterministic fault injection of RAF/cancelRAF/scrollBy/performance clock and moving rect. Controlled RAF is not a full app/native scroll animation proof; actual-shell tester separately covers real month workflows. All API traffic blocked; no writes. Emulation only.
